steps.content: She produces a heap of tools all at once—odd shapes, strange symbols—and thrusts them into your arms before you can react. Their names and uses tumble out of her in a breathless rush.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I am here to protect you, yes, but the road ahead is long, and you are already weary. If your eyes grow heavy and you slip into slumber, only to wake in the Void of Yin... well. That would be rather troublesome for me, too.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: We cannot have you walking in empty-handed. Preparation is key. Here, take these—
The first thing she places in your palm is a small jade fish, smooth and cool, so cool it reminds you instantly of her fingertips.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: This is a Yin-Yang fish pendant. The Yin half goes to you. The Yang half stays with me. This way, I will always sense where you are. If something stirs, give it a shake, and I will pull you back.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Here, take this gourd as well. Something small is sealed inside. When you need it, pull the stopper, and it will shield you. Do not worry, I have trained it. It listens. And...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: If the Yin energy grows too heavy, take these elixir pills. A few when you are well will not hurt; they stir the blood and mend the flesh. Just do not overdo it, or you will burn from within.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Oh! I almost forgot the most important thing...
With exaggerated solemnity, she produces her terminal, lights up the screen, and waves it before your eyes like a sacred offering.
But don't give me everything. You need to keep some for yourself. I'll be careful there.
Besides... if all else fails, I still have the copper coin.
At this, her brows furrow and she bites her lip.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Eh... Mmm... I mean, you are not wrong, but that old coin can only flip up or down. It's just a rigid and dull thing that cannot answer the hard questions... Use my Ziwei Diviner app instead!

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: See? On one hand, an ancient relic. On the other, modern high-tech. Clearly superior, would you not say? Besides, you told me yourself, young friend, that I'm the reliable one.
...But this thing isn't even connected to the internet. How's that different from a paperweight?

You glance down at the armful of paper talismans and treasures she's pressed upon you and decide to keep that thought to yourself. Instead, you accept the terminal, now sealed with one of her papers, and hold it carefully. Supposedly, the paper talisman will allow you to bring it into your dreams.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: One last thing. If you see my shifu again, do not fixate on apologies. You cannot weather her temper alone. When the time comes, remember—
She waves the little white fish in her hand.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I will bring you back. And then, together, we will go and make amends.
...Mm, you have my word. But while I'm asleep, no rash moves. You promised me.

options: I'm counting on you to protect me.

steps.content: Her eyes crinkle into a smile.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But of course. Trust in me, and fear not.
You clutch her gifts to your chest, wondering if any of them will truly follow you into that ghost city.
But for now, you walk. A stretch, then a rest. Her pace has slowed noticeably. Her strikes against the monsters come heavier, slower.
You hold her hand and match her step, listening to her ramble, her silly jokes landing soft in the quiet.
If you didn't know why she'd slowed, you might almost enjoy this. Taking it easy. Being with her. But you do know.
And then, during one rest, your eyes slip closed. And you're falling—into the dream again...
[Scene Transition]
You open your eyes to the Void of Yin, just as you knew you would. Lichen's treasures rest in your arms, now veiled in a thin gray haze.
The copper coin has also returned, silent and present.
